verdict.rationale: Slack documents an official MCP server that lets MCP clients search channels, read and send messages, manage canvases, users, files and lists. Workspace admins approve and manage MCP client integrations, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented connection/auth setup details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Slack MCP server provides tools for searching through Slack, retrieving and sending messages, managing canvases, managing users, uploading files, and working with lists.
your integrated apps can search channels, send messages, and perform other Slack actions through MCP clients
Workspace admins can approve and manage all MCP client integrations, keeping your Slack data safe.
